fact: WMO reports that a collaboration with EUMETSAT and AEMET enabled Chad to deploy satellite-based nowcasting (NWCSAF, RDT) to track convective events a few hours before they hit.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Chad among eight member states still pending a PUMA station as at 12 May 2026, under a Tecnavia service contract for all 49 member states.
